description: The record fd-{slug}-{env} goes last, so a failure part-way is repeated by the next run.

patches.find:
if [ "$remove_route" = true ]; then
    saf_info "  Removing the route of $slug from Front Door"
patches.replace:
if [ "$remove_route" = true ]; then
    az deployment group delete --name "$(jq -r '.deployment' "$plan")" --resource-group "$(jq -r '.resourceGroup' "$plan")" --only-show-errors --output none
    saf_info "  Removing the route of $slug from Front Door"
